headline: Hatzidakis: Greece third in the eurozone in terms of the size of support for the energy crisis
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Kostis Hatzidakis cited unemployment falling to 7.4% and stronger growth than the EU average. He also stressed the need to maintain fiscal responsibility and flexibility in EU fiscal rules.
why: Greece is a eurozone member whose fiscal policy and growth are watched by investors, particularly its government bonds. Energy-crisis support spending affects public finances.
